DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 提出先の案内をお持ちでしたら、必要な記載事項を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: If you have the receiving office's guidance, we can check the required entries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住まいの申込み用ですが、私一人の証明書でよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住宅申込で自分のみの証明書が必要と思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is for a housing application. I thought a certificate for just me was enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain you thought only your certificate was needed for the housing application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内には「世帯全員」とありますね。ご本人だけでよいか、提出先に確かめましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The guidance says “all household members.” Have you asked whether just yourself is sufficient?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、妻と子どもも同居しています。この指定なら三人分が必要ということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居家族三人と世帯全員の指定の関係を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. My wife and child live with me too. Does that instruction mean all three are needed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how the all-household instruction relates to your three cohabiting family members. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その意味を提出先に確認してから申請しましょう。不要な情報まで記載しないためにも、条件をそろえる必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us apply after checking that meaning with the recipient. Matching the requirements also avoids including unnecessary information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに「続柄」とありますが、何を表す言葉か教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 証明書案内の続柄という用語の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says “relationship” here. Please explain what that term means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what the certificate guidance term “relationship” means. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 世帯主との関係を表します。記載が必要かどうかも、提出先の条件で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: It means relationship to the household head. Check the recipient's requirements to see whether it must be included too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 世帯全員と続柄の二点を、不動産会社に電話で聞いてから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 世帯の範囲と続柄の記載条件を提出先へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will phone the real estate company about all household members and relationship, then return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check household scope and relationship-entry conditions with the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それがよいですね。回答をメモしておくと、窓口で希望を伝えやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Good. A note of the reply makes it easier to explain your request at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 電話で聞いた内容をこの案内に書き足して、申請のときに見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出先の回答を案内に書き窓口で示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will add the phone reply to this guidance and show it when applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will write the recipient's reply on the guidance and show it at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では確認後にお声がけください。いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then speak to us after checking. Goodbye for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の途中で手が止まっていますね。お手伝いできる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have paused while filling the questionnaire. Is there anything I can help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「安静時にも痛む」とありますが、安静時という言葉がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 問診票の安静時という言葉の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says “pain even at rest,” but I do not understand “at rest.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the questionnaire's meaning of “at rest.” Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 体を動かさずに休んでいるとき、という意味です。今はどんなときに痛みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: While resting without moving your body. When do you hurt now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 椅子に座っているときは平気で、立ち上がると右の腰が痛みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 座位では痛まず立ち上がると右腰が痛むと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sitting in a chair is fine, but the right side of my lower back hurts when standing up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain no pain sitting and right lower-back pain when standing up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを記入してください。痛みが始まった時期は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write that difference. Do you remember when the pain started?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方、箱を持ち上げてからです。痛みはその後ずっと同じくらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 痛みの開始時期ときっかけと強さの経過を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday evening after lifting a box. Since then the pain has stayed about the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the pain onset, trigger and course of intensity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 始まったきっかけと、強さが変わっていないことも医師に伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the doctor what started it and that the intensity has not changed too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「安静時は痛くない」と書いて、立つと痛むことを横に足せば伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 安静時と動作時の症状を書き分ける方法を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Would writing “no pain at rest” and adding beside it that standing hurts explain it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check how to distinguish resting and movement symptoms in writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、その書き方で状況が伝わります。診察でわからない言葉があれば、その場でもお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, that describes the situation. Ask during the consultation too if there is a word you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 聞いた言葉を自分の言い方で確かめながら、先生に説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察で用語を自分の言葉で確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain to the doctor while checking words I hear in my own wording.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm terms in your own words during the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では診察までお待ちください。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then wait for the consultation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談したい連絡が届いたとのことですね。どんな内容ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You received a message you want to discuss. What does it say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宅配業者を名乗るメッセージに、再配達のためカード番号が必要と書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宅配業者を名乗りカード番号を要求する連絡を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A message claiming to be a delivery company says my card number is needed for redelivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain a contact claiming to be a delivery company and asking for a card number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: リンクを開いたり、番号を入力したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you open the link or enter a number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 画面は開きましたが、カード番号を求められて変だと思い、何も入力せず閉じました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: リンクを開いたが何も入力せず閉じたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I opened the page, but thought asking for a card number was strange, so closed it without entering anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you opened the link but closed it without entering anything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経緯も確認します。実際に届く予定の荷物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check that sequence too. Are you expecting a real parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母からの荷物を待っているので、本当の連絡だと思いかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予定の荷物があり本物と思いかけた背景を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am waiting for a parcel from my mother, so nearly believed it was genuine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the expected parcel and why you nearly believed the message. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物の状況は、メッセージ内の連絡先ではなく、別に確認した業者の窓口で確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Check parcel status through a separately verified company contact, not the contact in the message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 母が持っている発送の控えから、業者を確かめて問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発送控えで業者を確かめ正規窓口へ問い合わせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will use my mother's shipping copy to identify the company and inquire.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the company from the shipping copy and contact its official office. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 届いたメッセージも確認したいので、受信時刻や相手の表示を残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We also want to check the message, so preserve its receipt time and sender display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メッセージは消さず、開いた時刻も思い出してメモしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受信メッセージとリンクを開いた時刻を保存すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not delete it, and will recall and note when I opened it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Save the received message and time you opened the link. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記録は今後の確認にも必要なので、保管しておいてください。ご相談ありがとうございました、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keep the records for further checks. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱の横にも送り状が付いていますが、以前のものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: There is a shipping label on the side too. Is that an old one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、通販の箱を使いました。今度は姉へ冬の服を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通販の箱を再利用して姉へ冬服を送ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I reused an online-shopping box. This time I am sending winter clothes to my older sister.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain reusing an online-shopping box to send winter clothes to your older sister. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい宛先と取り違えないよう、古い送り状をはがしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Remove the old label so it is not mistaken for the new address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: うまくはがれない部分は、宛先が見えないように隠せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: はがれない古い宛先を隠す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Can I cover the parts that do not peel off so the address cannot be seen?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to conceal the old address that will not peel off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 隠す方法も確認します。古いバーコードや住所が残らないように整えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the covering method too. Prepare it so no old barcode or address remains visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、このシールの残りも隠します。中は服だけですが、箱の大きさも測ってもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 古いシールも隠して箱の寸法確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will cover this sticker remnant too. It contains only clothes; could you measure the box too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Cover the old sticker and request checking the box dimensions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きさと重さを確認します。ふたは今のままできちんと閉まりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check size and weight. Does the lid close properly as it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 服を押し込みすぎたので、少し減らしてから閉め直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 詰めすぎた服を減らして箱を閉め直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I packed too many clothes, so will remove some and close it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will reduce the overpacked clothes and close the box again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ふたが浮かない状態にしてください。整えてから、料金と利用できる送り方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Make sure the lid does not bulge. Once ready, we will explain the fee and available shipping methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 服を減らして古い表示を隠し、新しい送り状を上面に貼って戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 古い表示を隠し新しい送り状を貼って持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will remove clothes, cover the old markings, affix the new label on top and return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will conceal old markings and return with a new label attached. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備ができたらこちらへどうぞ。お待ちしています、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Come here when ready. We will be waiting. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込の画面で、どの項目を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which item on the transfer screen would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を送るんですが、管理会社から名前の前に部屋番号を付けるよう言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃振込の依頼人名に部屋番号を付ける指定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending rent, and the management company said to put my room number before my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the room-number requirement in the rent transfer remitter name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取人ではなく、振込依頼人の表示ですね。指定は書面にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The remitter display, rather than the recipient. Is the instruction in writing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙に「三〇五、氏名」とあります。受取人の欄に入れるところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書面を示し受取人欄へ誤入力しかけたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This paper says “305, full name.” I nearly entered it in the recipient field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the instruction and say you nearly entered it in the wrong recipient field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受取人の欄は振込先の情報です。依頼人の表示を変更できるか、この機械の操作で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The recipient field is destination information. Let us check this machine's operation to see if the remitter display can change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここにある私の名前を、部屋番号付きに変えられるか見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 依頼人名の表示変更ができるか操作確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you see if my name here can be changed to include the room number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request checking whether the remitter-name display can change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 操作案内を確認します。変更できない場合は、別の手続き方法を窓口で相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the instructions. If it cannot, you can ask the counter about another procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もし変更できなければ、今は送らずに窓口で相談することにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更できない場合は振込を止め窓口へ相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it cannot change, I will not send now and will consult the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will stop the transfer and consult the counter if it cannot change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それがよいですね。入力できた場合も、確認画面で振込先と依頼人名を分けて見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Good. Even if you can enter it, check the destination and remitter name separately on the confirmation screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋番号は依頼人名に付け、振込先と金額も見直してから実行します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 依頼人名と振込先と金額を区別して確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will add the room number to my remitter name, then review the recipient and amount before executing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish and check remitter name, recipient and amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: わからないまま進めずに済みましたね。ご相談ありがとうございました、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You avoided proceeding without understanding. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの袋の底が少し開いているようですが、大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bag's bottom seems slightly open. Is it all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっきまでは気づきませんでした。瓶を買ったので、この袋に入れるのは心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参袋の破れで瓶を運ぶのが不安だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I had not noticed until now. I bought bottles and worry about putting them in this bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain concern about carrying bottles in your torn bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 瓶は重いですから、別の袋を使ったほうがよさそうですね。新しい袋は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Bottles are heavy, so another bag seems better. Do you need a new one?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 瓶が二本入る袋を一枚お願いします。袋代は商品と一緒に払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 瓶二本用の袋を求め袋代の支払方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One bag that holds two bottles, please. Can I pay for it with the goods?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a bag for two bottles and ask how to pay for it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、袋代を加えた合計をご確認いただきます。ほかの商品も同じ袋に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, please check the total with the bag fee. Will other goods go in that bag too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 卵は瓶と分けたいので、もう一枚袋を追加してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 卵と瓶を分けるため二枚目の袋を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want eggs separate from bottles, so add one more bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add a second bag to separate eggs and bottles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。袋が二枚になりますが、よろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. That makes two bags; is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二枚でお願いします。この破れた袋は持ち帰って、あとで直せるか見てみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋二枚を了承し破れた袋を持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Two, please. I will take the torn bag home and see later whether I can repair it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept two bags and say you will take the torn one home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では二枚分を加えます。画面の合計をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I will add two bags. Check the screen total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合計を確認しました。支払ったら、瓶を先に分けて詰めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合計を確認して瓶を分けて詰めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked it. After paying, I will separate and pack the bottles first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the total and say you will pack bottles separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 重いので気をつけてお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: They are heavy, so carry carefully. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 帽子が飛びそうですね。今日は風が強くなってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your hat looks ready to blow away. The wind is getting strong today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手で押さえながら歩くのは大変なので、帽子をしまって日陰を歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 強風で帽子をしまい日陰を歩きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is hard to walk holding it, so I want to put it away and walk in shade.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you will put away the hat in strong wind and walk in shade. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 木の下は枝にも注意が必要です。遠回りせず戻れる経路を案内しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Watch for branches under trees too. Shall I show a route back without a long detour?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね、木陰を長く歩くより、入口の近くで少しだけ歩くことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 木陰の長い経路を避け入口付近の短い散歩に変更する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Rather than a long shaded walk, I will walk just a little near the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Change from a long shaded route to a short walk by the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口脇の舗装路なら、すぐに戻れます。先の広場は風を受けやすいので、様子を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The paved path beside the entrance lets you return quickly. The square ahead catches the wind, so watch conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 広場まで行かずに引き返せば、今の入口へ戻れますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 広場前で引き返して同じ入口へ戻れるか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I turn before the square, I can return to this entrance, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm turning before the square returns to the same entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、同じ道を戻れます。歩きにくく感じたら、途中でも戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, along the same path. If walking becomes difficult, turn back even partway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帽子はかばんに入れました。休むなら入口の建物の近くで待てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帽子を収納した上で入口建物付近の休憩を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I put the hat in my bag. For a rest, may I wait near the entrance building?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Store the hat and ask about resting near the entrance building. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 建物の出入口をふさがない場所でお待ちください。休憩場所の表示も入口にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Wait somewhere that does not block the building entrance. Rest-area signs are also at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を見て休む場所を決めますが、風がさらに強くなったら散歩をやめて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩表示を確認し風が強まれば散歩を中止すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the sign and choose a resting place, but stop walking and go home if the wind strengthens further.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check rest signs and say you will stop the walk if the wind increases. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無理せずお過ごしください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Do not push yourself. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 表示が変わりましたので、ご乗車の前に列車名もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: The display changed, so check the train name before boarding too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 松江へ行くのですが、先に来た列車に乗れば一番早く着きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 松江へ最も早く到着する列車を発車順と関連づけて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to Matsue. Will the train that arrived first get me there earliest?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which train reaches Matsue earliest in relation to departure order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先ほど来た列車は途中で待つ予定です。後から来る普通列車のほうが先に到着する見込みです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The earlier train is scheduled to wait en route. The later local is expected to arrive first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先に出発しても、途中で追い越されるということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先発列車が途中で追い越されるという説明を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Even though it departs earlier, it will be overtaken along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the explanation that the earlier train is overtaken. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、今の案内ではそうなっています。次の普通列車は二番線から出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, according to current information. The next local departs platform two.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一番線で待っていたので、階段を使って二番線へ移ればよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一番線から二番線へ移る経路を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was waiting on one, so should use the stairs to two, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the route from platform one to two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 奥の階段から移れますが、まだ到着まで時間があります。お連れの方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can use the stairs farther inside, but there is still time before arrival. Is someone with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同僚が売店にいます。二番線へ移ると電話して、ここで合流してから行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 売店にいる同僚に連絡して合流後に移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: A coworker is in the shop. I will phone that we are moving to two, meet here, then go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Contact the coworker in the shop, meet, then move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら行き違いを防げますね。移動後も放送にご注意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: That prevents missing each other. Watch announcements after moving too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 放送で列車名をもう一度確かめてから乗ります。発車の順だけで決めなくてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 列車名を放送で再確認して乗車する方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm the train name again over the announcement before boarding. Good I did not decide only by departure order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the train name in announcements again before boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、松江までお気をつけて。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, take care on your way to Matsue. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの封筒から、相談したい通知を出していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you take the notice you want to discuss out of the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二枚が一緒に届きました。金額が違うので、二重に請求されたのか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同封された二枚の通知の金額差について二重請求の不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: These two came together. The amounts differ, and I worry I was billed twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Express concern about double billing because two enclosed notices differ in amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表題を見ると、こちらは税金、もう一枚は保険に関する通知です。担当は別になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The titles show this is tax and the other is insurance. Different departments handle them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ封筒でも用件は別なんですね。まず期限が近い保険のほうから聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用件が別と理解し期限の近い保険の相談を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Same envelope, different matters. I want to ask about insurance first since its deadline is sooner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand they differ and prioritize the insurance with the nearer deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では保険の窓口につなぎます。詳しく相談できる日時を確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will connect you to insurance. Shall we check a time for a detailed consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昼休みには戻れないので、来週水曜の午後に相談できるか聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来週水曜午後の相談可否を担当に照会してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I cannot return during lunch, so ask whether next Wednesday afternoon is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request checking with the department about next Wednesday afternoon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご希望は伝えられますが、予約できるかは担当の確認が必要です。連絡先も伺ってよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can convey your preference, but the department must confirm booking availability. May I also have contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この紙の番号へお願いします。勤務中は出られないため、折り返してよい時間も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話番号と勤務中に応答できない事情を伝えて折返し時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: This number on the paper. I cannot answer at work, so also want to know a good time to call back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your number and inability to answer at work, and ask callback times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も担当に伝えます。もう一枚の税金の通知は、保険の相談に混ぜずに分けておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell them that too. Keep the tax notice separate from the insurance consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 税金の紙は別の袋に入れます。予約の返事が来たら、保険の通知と質問メモを持参します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 税通知を分け予約の返事後に保険通知と質問メモを持参すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put tax in another bag. After the booking reply, I will bring the insurance notice and question notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate tax and bring insurance and question notes after a booking reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を受け付けました。担当からの連絡をお待ちください、今日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your request is accepted. Wait for the department's call. Thank you for today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 退院後に会社へ出す書類について、ご相談でしたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You wanted advice on company documents after discharge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社からこの用紙を渡されました。領収書を添えるだけで足りるのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社指定用紙に領収書を添えるだけでよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company gave me this form. I do not know whether just adding a receipt is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether adding a receipt to the company's form is enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここに医師の記入欄がありますね。看護師がこの欄を埋めることはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a doctor section here. A nurse cannot fill that part.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では会社に、病院の診断書で代わりになるか、この用紙への記入が必要か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診断書による代替か指定用紙への医師記入か会社に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will ask the company whether a hospital medical certificate can replace it or a doctor must fill this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the company about a medical-certificate substitute or doctor completion of its form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出先の希望がわかれば、書類の担当へ相談しやすくなります。提出期限は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Knowing the recipient's needs helps with the document office. Is there a submission deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金曜までです。すぐに受け取れるとは限らないと思うので、会社に期限の延長も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金曜の期限を示し受取時期未確定のため延長を会社に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Friday. Since it may not be available immediately, I will ask the company about extending the deadline too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the Friday deadline and request an extension because the document collection time is uncertain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それがよいですね。記入の受付方法や費用は、書類の種類が決まってから担当にお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Good. Ask the document office about application methods and cost once the type is decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日もらった領収書は先に保管して、会社の返事を聞いてから申請するつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 領収書を保存して会社の返答後に書類申請すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will store today's receipt first, then apply after the company's reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Save the receipt and apply for documents after the company responds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用紙に氏名を書く前に、記入する人の指定も見ておくと間違いを防げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before writing your name, checking who must fill each field also prevents mistakes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人が書く欄だけを埋めておきます。医師の欄と提出期限を質問メモに残しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人欄のみ記入し医師欄と提出期限を質問メモに残したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will fill only my own section. I noted the doctor section and deadline in my question notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Fill only your section and say you noted the doctor section and deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 手続きの相談も無理のない範囲で進めてください。どうぞお大事に、さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-32206-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Proceed with the consultation within your comfort. Take care. Goodbye.
